stem.text: In this question you should assume that the gas formed behaves as an ideal gas.
A $1.7\ \text{g}$ sample of $\text{Mg}$ reacts with $50.0\ \text{cm}^3$ of $2.2\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{HCl}$ at $303\ \text{K}$ and $110\,400\ \text{Pa}$.
Which volume of gas is produced, measured under these conditions?
